## Versions

Game build, launcher/core, addon version, operating system and other active HUD addons.

## Reproduction

Steps, expected behaviour and actual behaviour.

## Evidence

Relevant screenshots or a short sanitized log excerpt.
State whether the data is synthetic or from a real session.
Do not attach saves, credentials or personal telemetry recordings.
